name: io.github.matinfo-tech/markdown-pdf-export
description: Export Markdown files to PDF with Chromium: highlighting, KaTeX math, TOC, headers/footers.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_PDF_SETTINGS
environmentVariables.description: Default export settings as JSON, e.g. {"page_format":"Letter"}

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_PDF_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser to use: chrome, msedge, chromium, or a path to an executable
